input.title: State Street Bank Lending Pass-Through account retirement at DTCC
input.summary: DTCC notice 25231-26 announces the retirement of a State Street Bank & Trust Company Lending Pass-Through account (#7268), representing an operational change impacting a DTCC participant/member.
evidence_quotes: Additional Account Retirement: STATE STREET BANK & TRUST COMPANY/LENDING PASS-THROUGH, #7268
Updates/changes impacting DTCC Participant(s)/Member(s) and/or Sponsored Member(s) noted here.
input.notes: Summary-only DTCC notice. The notice records an account retirement for a State Street Bank lending pass-through account. State Street is a major participant (global custodian/settling bank), so reach is set to 2/major_participant. However, this appears to be a routine administrative account retirement rather than a stress or default signal; stage is set to 1 as the lowest XE-MEMBER stage, but confidence is low. No stress, downgrade or default language is present. Effect_date set to announced_date as no separate effective date is given.
